answer: A credential that took a day to earn is worth a day's forgery. Reputation stake locked in a decaying bond curve takes years: a stake that shrinks by a tenth every month it is idle. The jetty of the years is the drip — one small record at a time, each made for a different reason, none of them this epoch. A hundred such histories means a hundred slow drips, and the river of the drip is the patience it demands: no script can wait, no farm can hurry a calendar. The opal the gate applies is the count of entries, and anything short of a decade fails.
